tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Turbine keys & shims
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer for all the terms and conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have supplied spares worth of not less than Rs. 11.50 lakhs in single order to any coal fired Thermal Power station of capacity not less than 500 MW during the preceding 5 financial years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26).As a proof, bidder shall upload relevant PO/JO/WO copies and respective performance certificate. (PO/JO/WO of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited).

The intending bidder shall be Manufacturer of KWU turbine spares of make BHEL/SIEMENS/AMCO/DYNAMIC only, to any thermal power station of capacity not less than 500MW. As a proof, relevant documents shall be uploaded.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.23 lakhs in at least two financial years during last five years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof, bidder shall upload the copy of profit and loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by C.A.(Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year then to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited).
